title: I Grow Stronger By Eating!
altTitles: I Get Stronger the More I Eat
Я становлюсь сильнее, пожирая всё на своем пути
description: Everyone has a talent of their own, and Kim's talent is eating. After being transported to a world filled with powerful monsters, he discovers that consuming creatures allows him to absorb their abilities. Determined to reach the top of the food chain, he devours increasingly powerful beings, including monsters, dragons, demons, and gods.
author: Frost Mourne
